title: Spiced Tofu Bowl with Basil Slaw, Cucumber, Avocado & Sesame Sauce

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; crumble tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add garlic and spices; cook, stirring often, until the tofu begins to brown, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger; place in a small bowl along with tahini, oil, vinegar, water, soy sauce, and maple syrup. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Place in a large bowl (reserving a small amount for garnish).
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the basil, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine.
Trim and thinly slice cucumber crosswise into rounds.
Halve and pit avocado. Slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide slaw between bowls; top with tofu, cucumber, avocado, and reserved basil. Drizzle sauce over top and enjoy!
